messages:
Carmen: quick FYI  the sidebar link under 'Runtime -> deployment patterns' to 'dedicated-capacity' 404s on staging. clicked from /runtime/index -> sidebar.
Owen: thanks, does it point to /runtime/dedicated-capacity or a different slug?
Carmen: it points to /runtime/dedicated-pool (old slug) while page is now /runtime/dedicated-capacity after the rework. looks like the sidebar wasn't updated.
doc-review-bot: link-scan: detected stale sidebar href /runtime/dedicated-pool in navigation. created DOCS-9999.
Carmen: small fix: update the sidebar nav config (site/nav.yml) to the new slug and add a redirect for the old path so external links keep working.
Samir: I can pick the redirect. Carmen can you do the nav yml change? tag me in the PR and I'll add the tiny redirect rule.
Carmen: opened PR: https://git.internal.redwood.io/docs/pr/9001  updates site/nav.yml and includes a redirect in content/_redirects.yaml. local commands I used:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/nav-dedicated-slug
sed -i "s|/runtime/dedicated-pool|/runtime/dedicated-capacity|g" site/nav.yml
echo "/runtime/dedicated-pool /runtime/dedicated-capacity 301" >> content/_redirects.yaml
git commit -am "docs(nav): fix runtime dedicated slug and add redirect"
git push origin fix/nav-dedicated-slug
```
Owen: nice. tiny request: add a one-line frontmatter changelog to the target doc so release notes mention the nav fix. also add a smoke preview test that follows the redirect.
Carmen: added changelog: "fix sidebar nav slug" and a preview assertion. pinging @Samir for the redirect review.
Samir: quick look  redirect format ok, nav edit minimal. approved.
doc-review-bot: PR 9001 passed CI and was merged by Owen. staging preview rebuilt. DOCS-9999 resolved.
Carmen: confirmed staging: sidebar link resolves and old path redirects to the new page. closing DOCS-9999. thanks all for the quick assist! :rocket:
